A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment
1 2
1. Audi xenon plus headlights with LED daytime running lights | The
sophisticated, high-intensity discharge headlights produce about twice
as much light as comparable halogen headlights. They make night
driving, particularly in poor weather, safer and easier for the driver’s
eyes. LED daytime running lights consume less energy than conventional
daytime running lights and add a signature look to the A8 and A8 L.
2. Audi music interface with iPod® integration | The Audi music interface
offers intelligent integration with the iPod.® Any iPod® Generation 4 and
higher [iPod,® iPod® nano, iPod® photo] may be connected through the
glove box, and full iPod® controls are available through the MMI® screen.
3. Leather-wrapped, four-spoke, multifunction steering wheel |
The leather-wrapped, four-spoke design has a refined look and feel.
The multifunction controls provide easy access to audio volume control,
navigation, voice prompts and telephone dialing, radio and CD
33 track selection.
+ SIRIUS® Satellite Radio | Enjoy commercial-free music, talk and more,
available with a trial subscription to the SIRIUS® Satellite Radio network.
+ Voice recognition | The Audi voice control system can be used to operate
the most important navigation, radio and hands-free car phone functions
by speaking the necessary commands.
+ Audi adaptive lights | Utilizing input from the steering and speed of the
vehicle, adaptive headlights pivot up to 15 degrees to allow the driver to
see ahead in the dark by lighting up corners more effectively.
+ Auto-dimming interior mirror | The rearview mirror recognizes distracting
bright light behind the car and darkens the mirror glass automatically.
+ E ight-color LCD driver information display | Conveniently located in
the instrument panel, this user-friendly interface includes radio, telephone
and navigation data, as well as information on the current operating
status, which monitors the condition of the vehicle components.
+ FEAtURE not Shown
16

--- page 11 ---
A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment
4
4. 16-way power seats | The 16-way power seats come equipped with a
memory system and adjustment for forward/backward position, seat
height, seat and backrest angle and electric lumbar support.
5. Audi parking system advanced | The rearview camera offers a
real-time view of the parking area while front and rear parking sensors
use ultrasound waves to sense your position and warn when approaching
nearby objects.
6. Bluetooth® | The Bluetooth® hands-free phone interface allows
you to pair a Bluetooth®-enabled mobile phone with your Audi and
access your phonebook within the driver information display in your
instrument panel. For specific compatibility and operation, refer to
audiusa.com/bluetooth or contact your local Audi dealer for the
latest listing of compatible phones.
7. Rear spoiler integrated into trunk lid | The sporty and elegant look of
the A8 is accented by the rear spoiler integrated into the trunk lid.
[Available on the A8 only]
5 6
+ 19" seven-double-spoke wheels with 255/40 all-season tires |
The seven-double-spoke design and finish of the wheels complement
the elegant and powerful lines of the Audi A8. The lightweight alloy
helps to improve driving dynamics, while the all-season tires help to
enhance handling. [Available on the A8 only]
+ heated front seats | The power heated seats allow the driver and
passenger to electronically adjust the seats’ forward/backward position,
seat height, lumbar support, and angle of seat cushion and seatback.
The multilevel seat-heating system is designed to heat the entire surface
of the seat; warming is initiated with a convenient button.
+ Memory for driver seat and mirrors | The memory system automatically
adjusts the seat’s forward/backward position, seat height, lumbar
support, angle of seat cushion, seatback and outside mirror settings
based on the key or button that is being used.
+ homeLink® garage door opener | HomeLink® is integrated into the
7
overhead controls and uses a three-button system that controls
garage doors, gates and even lights in the home.
+ FEAtURE not Shown

--- page 12 ---
A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment
1 4
1. MMI® Advanced with retractable seven-inch color display | The MMI®
provides an easy-to-use interface for the advanced technology of the
A8. MMI® connects you with every advanced system of your Audi, making
a remarkable vehicle an intuitive extension of yourself. Controlling
everything from the DVD-based navigation system to the Bluetooth®
communications will become second nature. The driver can manage
audio, telephone and vehicle systems with ease, creating a driving
experience like no other.
2. tire pressure monitoring system | The tire pressure monitoring system
notifies the driver when tire pressure is above or below acceptable levels.
It oversees the pressure in all four tires while the car is being driven and
warns the driver in the event of pressure loss with symbols in the driver
information system.
3. Advanced key | With Audi advanced key, the car can be unlocked
and started without removing the key from a pocket or purse. At the
same time, the steering can be released and the ignition turned on
electronically – all without inserting the key in the ignition.
4. Front seat ventilation and massage | In addition to 16-way power
seating adjustments, the A8 L seat ventilation feature helps regulate
heat and moisture by means of a fan in each of the front seatbacks,
2 3 activated by a button within the climate control unit. The massage unit
helps relax back muscles with the movement of lumbar elements and
is activated by a button on the side of the seat. [Optional on A8]
+ w ood decorative inlays | The genuine wood decorative inlays in the
dash, center console and door panels add a refined touch of luxury
to the A8 and A8 L.
+ B oSE® Surround Sound with AudioPilot® noise compensation | The
14 speakers include a center speaker and subwoofer matched with
an eight-channel DSP amplifier with a total output of 255 watts. A
microphone measures noise level and adjusts radio volume accordingly,
resulting in balanced sound, despite background noise.
+ FEAtURE not Shown

--- page 13 ---
A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment A8 | A8 L Standard Equipment
5 7 8
5. Contrast stitching | Accent-colored stitching and piping are featured
along the sides of the vehicle’s seats, enhancing the interior’s detail
and distinction. [Available on A8 L only]
6. headlight washers | The retractable, high-pressure headlight washers
are concealed in the front bumper and are activated when the driver
washes the windshield while the headlights are on to help ensure radiant
and clear xenon light.
7. Four-zone climate control | Both driver and front passenger as well
as the occupants of the outer rear seats can select their required
temperature and distribution of air individually for their particular seat.
[Optional on A8]
8. Auto-dimming and folding exterior mirrors | The exterior mirrors 9
with automatic dimming recognize glaringly bright headlight beams
behind the car and darken the mirror glass automatically. The folding
feature helps protect the mirrors by collapsing them inward to fit in
tight spaces.
6
9. Leather-wrapped shift knob with aluminum accents | The quality
and craftsmanship of leather and aluminum accents detail the overall
interior excellence of the A8.
+ Power door close assist | The front and rear doors of the A8 are
equipped with a power door close assist feature. This provides enhanced
comfort and convenience when entering and exiting the vehicle.
+ Power one-touch trunk open/close | The trunk can be opened automatically
with the touch of a button found in three useful locations: on the vehicle’s
key, on the lower side panel of the driver’s door, and on the trunk lid itself.
Additionally, a hands-free close button is found on the inside of the trunk lid.
+ FEAtURE not Shown
